papers.verified_title: Do Deep Ensembles Actually Capture Uncertainty in Graph Neural Networks?
papers.saved_takeaway: Authors report limited functional diversity and uncertainty gains for independently initialized GCN/GATv2; graph-transformer scope excluded and functional-convexity explanation remains a hypothesis. Their probability pooling differs from our primary raw-logit pool.
papers.relationship_to_GNNM: Motivation and relevant uncertainty baseline; neither graph ensemble collapse nor diversification is a new claim for our work.
